title: The square maximises the ratio of the first two Dirichlet eigenvalues among quadrilaterals
creator: Anonymous

claims.statement: For every simple quadrilateral Q in R^2, convex or not, lambda_2(Q)/lambda_1(Q) <= 5/2 for the Dirichlet Laplacian, with equality if and only if Q is a square.
claims.latex: \forall Q \text{ simple quadrilateral}:\ \lambda_2(Q)/\lambda_1(Q)\le 5/2,\ \text{equality iff } Q \text{ is a square}
claims.definitions: A simple quadrilateral is the open region bounded by a closed four-sided polygon without self-intersections whose interior angles all differ from pi; if an angle equals pi the region is a triangle and the triangle theorem applies.

claims.statement: For every convex quadrilateral Q, lambda_2/lambda_1 <= 5/2, with equality iff Q is a square.
If c_i <= eta c_{i+2} for some i then xi(Q) <= (7/3)(1+eta)^2; xi < 5/2 when eta <= 0.035.
For every bounded convex planar domain with s = width/diameter and every theta in (0,1): xi <= 4 s^2/theta^2 + 1/(1-theta)^2; with theta = 1/4, xi <= 64 s^2 + 16/9 <= 2.4178 < 5/2 for s <= 1/10.

claims.method: inertia criterion (Lemma 3.1) for a 3x3 Rayleigh-Ritz pencil of transported modes, Kato-Temple bound, multivariate Taylor models (N=10, m=12, m_LL=14, rho_0=1/10); exact first-order structure (Lemma 3.2, Corollary 3.3)

evidence.certifiedObjects: 960 direction boxes x 10 s-intervals (8320 decided by det S, 1280 by tr S)

claims.statement: For every convex Q_p with 0 < |p|_inf <= 0.225, xi(Q_p) < 5/2.
claims.method: shell 0.049 < |p|_inf <= 0.225: Rayleigh-Ritz upper bound for lambda_2, Lehmann-Goerisch lower bound for lambda_1 with a global polynomial flux

evidence.certifiedObjects: 8217 leaves: 8216 certificates (8209 Lehmann-Goerisch, 7 domain monotonicity), 1 exclusion

claims.statement: Every convex Q_p in the fundamental domain outside the region of Theorem 3, Lemma A and Lemma B, and not in the band of Lemma B', satisfies xi(Q_p) < 5/2.
claims.method: test functions and Piola-transformed flux transported from the box centre by a piecewise-affine map

evidence.certifiedObjects: 50183 leaves: 31426 certificates, 18756 exclusion and compound leaves, 1 shell leaf by exact containment

claims.statement: Every convex quadrilateral with 1/10 < width/diameter <= 2/5 satisfies xi < 5/2.
claims.method: diameter-normalised charts; Born-Oppenheimer lower bound for lambda_1 certified by Sturm oscillation; weighted one-dimensional Ritz upper bound for lambda_2

claims.statement: For every simple non-convex quadrilateral (dart) Q, xi(Q) < 5/2.
claims.method: analytic lemmas (shallow notch, collapse collar, thin wedges, flat hull, tails, mixed-boundary bracketing, one-dimensional bounds with exponential tails) and certified covers (finite elements with Liu's lower bound and a Temple step, one-dimensional BO2 bounds, inclusion) in charts uniform in the arm lengths; exact global decomposition (Supplement S, Theorem 13.2)

claims.statement: For the isosceles trapezoid direction b the exact first-order term of xi vanishes; rule (3.16) of Arbon (2022) gives -sqrt(16384+729 pi^4)/(18 pi^2) ~ -1.664 per unit t (or -3/2 for two simultaneous two-vertex moves); for one two-vertex move the true slope is -3/4 and the rule gives ~ -0.832.

notClaimed: the supremum of xi over darts (the value 7/3 in §5.1 is a numerical observation, not proved and not used)
